about: Words with which Playwright or the browser says that the browser, or one of its processes, went away under a test. An e2e attempt whose error contains one, or during which a page's console or page error showed one (apps/demo/e2e/evidence.ts records them), ended in a browser crash (scripts/ci/e2e-report.mjs). Only wordings seen in this repository's CI are listed, each with a run where it was seen.
